headline: Ravens acquire center Cam Jurgens in trade with Eagles
summary: The Ravens have acquired two-time Pro Bowl center Cam Jurgens in a trade with the Eagles.

headline: Lamar Jackson out of Wednesday's Week 5 practice
summary: The Ravens have brought in a new center, but they don't currently have a healthy quarterback.

headline: Jayden Daniels On Track To Return In Week 5; Marcus Mariota Sprains MCL
summary: After missing back-to-back games with a dislocated left elbow, Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels is trending toward returning in Week 5. As the Commanders prepare to face the NFC East rival Giants on Sunday, head coach Dan Quinn said Daniels will be a full participant in practice this week (via Tashan Reed of the Washington Post). headline: Odell Beckham Jr. signs with Vikings on practice squad
summary: The Vikings are signing wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr. to their practice squad, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

headline: Kevin Byard: Mike Vrabel used Allen Iverson video to get Patriots "stepping over people"
